incidents.name: LPMine reward accrual not reset on claim
incidents.notes: LPMine computes rewards from the pair's current balance via partakeAddLp() and does not update the last-claim timestamp on extractReward(), so the same LP position could be claimed repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x6BBeF6DF8db12667aE88519090984e4F871e5feb created 2025-01-02T05:35:10Z by 0x114faa79157c6ba61818ce2a383841e56b20250b, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x593749d5414d8a735cda16e4b47cc9bfa47d5683; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
